require "formula"

RSpec.describe Formula do
  describe "::new" do
    it "selects stable by default" do
      f = formula do

        head "foo"
      end

      expect(f).to be_stable
    end

      f = formula { url "foo-1.0" }
      expect(f).to be_stable
